name: NOAHS_HOUSEHOLD
canonical: the eight souls of Noah's household, aged Noah and his elderly wife with his three grown sons and their three young wives, an ancient Near-Eastern family of weathered olive skin and dark or greying hair, clad in coarse undyed and earth-toned woven robes and head-coverings, gathered close together as one family
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
